description: Create a company licence for our self-study video courses in a customer's own LMS (SCORM 1.2 dispatch package). A seat is taken the first time a new LMS learner starts; seats are freed only by an admin. Superadmins only; called by an agent, it is parked for approval. Afterwards build the ZIP with lms_package_build.

customer_ref.description: optional order, invoice or contact reference

customer_tenant_id.description: optional DelegAIze tenant id of the customer

fachsystem.description: business system key from src/config/fachsysteme.ts, only for product fach (e.g. bookaize)

language.description: course language(s); one ZIP per language. Default de

product.description: course: user | user_online | developer | consultant | fach (business system, needs fachsystem)

valid_until.description: end of the licence: YYYY-MM-DD (end of day UTC) or ISO date-time

name: lms_license_create
